description: Digitized geospatial dataset of ground-mounted solar energy panel-rows in the United States is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Charles Bonten, Jacob Stid (Michigan State University). Overview This project provides manually digitized solar panel-rows to fill gaps in and enhance coverage of solar array sub-array design metadata in the US. In doing so, this dataset supports the existing project, The Ground-Mounted Solar Energy in the United States (GM-SEUS) dataset, recently published in Scientific Data. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
